app.name: CIQ Digital
app.description: Internal Beiersdorf backend for the Cosmetic Ingredient Questionnaire (CIQ): cases from creation to the final PDF with a parallel department review, open points, change requests, suppliers, versioned configuration, released sections, scope runs, RMES sheets, internal notes and a tamper-evident audit trail. Suppliers work only in the separate portal.

roles.name: Admin
roles.rationale: Platform default required by A3 (brd.md L67). Reused, never created. No business journey.

roles.name: User
roles.rationale: Platform default required by A3 (brd.md L67). Reused, never created. No business journey.

roles.name: CIQ RMM
roles.rationale: Creates the case and holds every 'Waiting for supplier' step, Scope check, both open-items checks and the RMM branch of Part 2 (brd.md L157, L184-L193). Holds 'Waiting for supplier' and 'Review – RMM' on CIQ Open Point and Triage on CIQ Change Request (L245-L246, L270). Writes CIQ Supplier, CIQ Section and CIQ Scope Run (L278-L281).

roles.name: CIQ Regulatory Reviewer
roles.rationale: Owns 'Review – Regulatory' on CIQ Case and on CIQ Open Point, and 'Assess – Regulatory' on CIQ Change Request (brd.md L144, L189, L246, L271). Raises open points (L237). Sole editor of CIQ RMES Regulatory and records its own internal RMES decision (A3 L64; L282-L283).

roles.name: CIQ Safety Reviewer
roles.rationale: Owns 'Review – Safety' on CIQ Case and on CIQ Open Point, and 'Assess – Safety' on CIQ Change Request (brd.md L144, L189, L246, L271). Raises open points (L237). Sole editor of CIQ RMES Safety and records its own internal RMES decision (A3 L64; L282-L283).

roles.name: CIQ QM Reviewer
roles.rationale: Owns 'Review – QM' on CIQ Case and on CIQ Open Point, and 'Assess – QM' on CIQ Change Request (brd.md L144, L189, L246, L271). Raises open points (L237).

roles.name: CIQ Microbiology Reviewer
roles.rationale: Owns 'Review – Microbiology' on CIQ Case and on CIQ Open Point, and 'Assess – Microbiology' on CIQ Change Request (brd.md L144, L189, L246, L271). Raises open points (L237).

roles.name: CIQ Sustainability Reviewer
roles.rationale: Owns 'Review – Sustainability' on CIQ Case and on CIQ Open Point, and 'Assess – Sustainability' on CIQ Change Request (brd.md L144, L189, L246, L271). Raises open points (L237).

roles.name: CIQ Overall Approver
roles.rationale: Owns 'Overall approval' on CIQ Case, which runs only when switched on (brd.md L145, L159, L191; A3 L63).

roles.name: CIQ Business Admin
roles.rationale: Writes CIQ Config Version, including Release rows, with no four-eyes (brd.md L146, L279; A3 L65).

roles.name: CIQ Reader
roles.rationale: One read-only role for Customs, Legal, Auditor and Process Owner (brd.md L147; PART D L1241). It may post internal notes (open question Q7 default).

roles.name: CIQ Case Admin
roles.rationale: Ends a case during Part 2 through the admin route and ends the case's open points and change requests (brd.md L148, L215, L217). Flow Admin is set over REST after generate (A2 L56; L416). Its members also hold CIQ RMM (PART D L1242).

roles.name: CIQ Integration Service
roles.rationale: The CIQ Sync Service and the integrations: creates CIQ Change Request at Start (Y6), writes CIQ Section and CIQ Audit Event (brd.md L149, L269, L280, L285; A3 L61). Never acts on a human step after Start (A2 L58).

journey_scenarios.intent: Regulatory raises a point (to supplier: Yes); Waiting for supplier runs; only Review – Regulatory runs; Accepted; End.
Safety raises a point (to supplier: Yes); Waiting for supplier runs; only Review – Safety runs; Accepted; End.
QM raises a point (to supplier: Yes); Waiting for supplier runs; only Review – QM runs; Accepted; End.
Microbiology raises a point (to supplier: No); Waiting for supplier is skipped; only Review – Microbiology runs; Accepted; End.
Sustainability raises a point (to supplier: No); Waiting for supplier is skipped; only Review – Sustainability runs; Accepted; End.
RMM raises a point (to supplier: No); Waiting for supplier is skipped; only Review – RMM runs; Accepted; End.
RMM raises a supplier query routed to Microbiology; the owner withdraws it at review.
CIQ QM Reviewer attempts Review – Regulatory on a Regulatory point (REQ-PROC-034).
CIQ Overall Approver attempts to raise an open point (only RMM and the five department Reviewers raise, L237).
Y6 creates the request; RMM triages 'Accepted' with every Impact flag Yes; all five Assess branches run with 'No impact confirmed'; join; End (X6).
Y6 creates the request; RMM triages 'Accepted – scope extended' with every Impact flag Yes; all five Assess branches run with 'Re-assessed'; join; End (X6).
Y6 creates the request; RMM triages 'Accepted' with every Impact flag Yes; all five Assess branches run with 'Finding raised'; join; End (X6).
RMM creates the request by hand (fallback); triage flags only Safety and QM; the other three branches are skipped; End.
Triage 'Refused – after final release': every Impact flag No, so all five Assess branches are skipped and the all-skipped join must still reach End (AR01 / K-PAR).
Triage 'Refused – not valid': every Impact flag No, so all five Assess branches are skipped and the all-skipped join must still reach End (AR01 / K-PAR).
CIQ Regulatory Reviewer attempts Triage (RMM only).
CIQ Sustainability Reviewer attempts Assess – Microbiology.
